sections.body: LA has made 73.3% of field goals [kc1] on 15 tries [kc2], but its only long-range try was missed (0.0% [kc3] on 1 attempt [kc4]), so trust its range only to the mid-forties. Mevis made 5 [kc5] early and McManus has made 5 [kc7] since the kicker change. GB is at 71.4% [kc9] on 21 attempts [kc10]. LA punts net 40.5 yards [kc11] with 30.3% inside the 20 [kc13], so field position should favor GB. Touchbacks are 31.4% [kc14] for LA versus 10.0% [kc16] for GB, but LA's coverage allows 27.4 yards per return [kc18], so GB's returner can still get a long start. LA punt returners average 4.1 yards [kc20], so GB can kick away from them with little risk.

sections.heading: Injuries and availability
sections.body: Rams: G Steve Avila is Out after playing 91.1% of snaps [ic3] over 9 games [ic4], so expect a backup at left guard. TE Terrance Ferguson is Out. TE Davis Allen is Questionable with a 51.8% snap share [ic7] over 10 games [ic8] but only a 4.7% target share [ic9], so losing him mostly costs run blocking and formation flexibility. CB Trent McDuffie is Questionable with a 95.0% snap share [ic12] over 7 games [ic13]. Packers: RB Josh Jacobs is Out after a 17.1% rush share [ic15] on 210 team rushes [ic16], so the backfield work shifts to the next back. LB Micah Parsons, TE Josh Whyle and C Sean Rhyan are also Out.

sections.heading: Key matchups
sections.body: Pressure decides the early downs: LA brings a 28.0% blitz rate [mc1] and a 12.3% pressure proxy [mc2], and GB's offense has allowed a 17.4% pressure proxy [mc3]. Rebuild interior protection after LG Steve Avila was listed Out [mc4]. Puka Nacua takes 25.6% of Rams targets [mc5] across 363 targets [mc6], so keep coverage in front of him and tackle after the catch, since average target depth is only 7.6 yards [mc7]. LA runs between the tackles on 47.4% of designed runs [mc8], and GB must replace Josh Jacobs, who is Out [mc9]. Expect Marshawn Lloyd (29.0% of rushes) [mc10] and Kenneth Johnson (24.8%) [mc11] to share the load. LA allows 37.9% run success [mc12] with a 6.7-man box [mc13], so the box count decides whether GB can run at all. Only 30.3% of LA punts land inside the 20 [mc14], so GB can play for field position.
